Format.description: The file's format name; first key of the file.

Version.description: The format version this build writes; older versions are migrated when read.

Seed.description: The seed of the noise layers' generators.

Volume.description: The sound's linear volume, from 0 to 1.

SoundLayer.description: One oscillator of a sound effect: a note sequence or a frequency sweep.

DutyCycle.description: Square waves only: the fraction of each period spent high.

Notes.description: Notes played back to back, such as "C5:0.06" (name, octave, seconds) or "R:0.1" (a rest).

Duration.description: Without notes: the sweep's length in seconds.

StartFrequency.description: Without notes: the sweep's first frequency.

EndFrequency.description: Without notes: the sweep's last frequency (an exponential glide).

Volume.description: The layer's linear volume, from 0 to 1.

Envelope.description: The volume envelope of each note.

LowPass.description: The cutoff of a one-pole low-pass filter in Hz; 0 leaves the layer unfiltered.

Delay.description: Seconds from the sound's start until the layer starts.

SoundEnvelope.description: The ADSR volume envelope every note of a layer plays with.

Attack.description: Seconds from silence to full level at the note's start.

Decay.description: Seconds from full level down to the sustain level.

Sustain.description: The level held until the note ends, from 0 to 1.

Release.description: Seconds from the sustain level to silence after the note ends.
